title: Pasting equations for transported proper/open gamma
statement: For fixed Operations, Compositors, OpenComparisons, and a supplied proper/open gamma, the vertical, horizontal, and cartesian base-change equations of ProperOpenCoherence hold.

proof.text: Transport each intrinsic vertical, horizontal, and base-change mate-pasting equation through the bridge. Naturality moves bridge maps to endpoints and adjacent inverse pairs cancel, leaving the displayed equations.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemProperOpenTransportPasting (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (a : OpenComparisons l E o c)
    (gamma : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
      (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
      (_h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i),
      Operations.push l E o r ⋙ Operations.shriek l E o i ⟶
        Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p) :
    Nonempty (ProperOpenTransportPasting l E o c a gamma)
